answer: Assembling that for 93 aliases means 93 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each comet escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the haven ledger records every share and the relic audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 9 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
